text:
Ilya (CS): Pulled together feedback from onboarding + first-week usage for 12 customers. Main themes: per-route cost visibility, rate-card clarity, and embedders cost controls. Need quick triage. Reactions: :white_check_mark: = take to roadmap, :mag: = needs research, :warning: = renewal risk

feedback-bot: Uploaded onboarding_batch_2026_05_10.csv (12 rows). Auto-tags: per-route-billing, invoices, rate-card, embeddings, docs.

Marta (PM): can we sort by ARR and "asks_that_reduce_churn"? high-ARR churn items first.

Ilya (CS): done. Pasting top 3 rows for visibility:
```
customer,tier,ask
AtlasLabs,A,export per-route cost CSV and daily rollup for billing reconciliation
GreenFleet,A,clarify rate-card mapping between model-size and per-embedding unit cost in console
PaperTrail,B,ability to set per-route embedding model alias to cheaper model for low-priority routes
```

Asha (Finance): AtlasLabs export would unblock their procurement sign-off. If it's an easy export + schema doc, we can accept earlier billing snapshots.

Jon (Eng): PaperTrail routing is straightforward: add alias mapping + runtime flag. Low risk.

Marta (PM): Reacting :white_check_mark: to AtlasLabs export and PaperTrail routing. :mag: to GreenFleet rate-card docs, that looks like product copy + console surface.

Ilya (CS): Flagging GreenFleet as :warning: renewal risk  they called out unexpected per-usage charges in onboarding calls.

feedback-bot: Note: 3 accounts tagged as "at-risk" during import: GreenFleet, NovaRetail, AtlasLabs.

Asha (Finance): For AtlasLabs, can CS attach a sample invoice and the routes they expect? We need to validate the export schema against our billing events.

Ilya (CS): Uploading sample invoice now and linking to sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/billing-triage-1776004321 (placeholder)

Jon (Eng): Quick technical note: per-route export can be generated from our usage-aggregator with a new SQL view; estimate 2-3 dev-days to hook to API + one-week QA. Fast follow: ad-hoc CSV dump from analytics job is possible in 1 day for manual delivery.

Marta (PM): Good split. Let's offer the 1-day manual CSV to the customer as an interim and plan the API export as roadmap work.

Ilya (CS): Customers appreciate interim timelines. One process ask: please call out anything that's a hard no (privacy/regulatory) so CS stops promising features.

Asha (Finance): If export exposes raw PII fields we must mask. But per-route cost is fine if it only contains route_id, total_tokens, cost_units.

Jon (Eng): Confirmed  export will only include aggregated metrics, no customer-provided content.

Marta (PM): Scheduling a 30-min billing triage tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: 1) AtlasLabs CSV interim delivery plan, 2) GreenFleet rate-card doc ownership, 3) PaperTrail model-alias PoC. Invite: @Ilya @Jon @Asha

Ilya (CS): will nudge the A-tier CSMs to set expectation for interim CSV and follow-up after triage. Thanks team :thumbsup:
